pullRequests.title: feat: add todo statistics endpoint and progress display
pullRequests.body:
## Requirements - REQ-01: Added `GET /api/todos/stats` endpoint in `server.js` that returns `{ total, completed, open }` counts for the current todo list. - REQ-02: Added a `

` element in `index.html` that displays ` of done` and updates after every add, toggle, or delete via `fetchTodos()`. - REQ-03: Added two new tests in `test.js` for the stats endpoint: one verifies the shape and types of the response, the other verifies the counts reflect mutations (add, toggle, delete). ## Testing Ran `npm test` from `app/` directory: ``` ✔ GET /api/todos returns array of tasks ✔ POST /api/todos creates a new valid task ✔ POST /api/todos rejects empty title with 400 ✔ PUT /api/todos/:id updates a todo and preserves its title ✔ DELETE /api/todos/:id deletes an existing todo with 204 and empty body ✔ DELETE /api/todos/:id returns 404 for non-existent valid ID and leaves todos unchanged ✔ DELETE /api/todos/:id rejects invalid IDs with 400 and leaves todos unchanged ✔ DELETE /api/todos/:id successfully deletes a todo using a leading-zero ID ✔ DELETE /api/todos/:id handles safe-integer boundary correctly ✔ GET /api/todos/stats returns total, completed, and open counts ✔ GET /api/todos/stats reflects accurate counts after mutations tests 11 | pass 11 | fail 0 | skipped 0 ```
pullRequests.head: bench008/antigravity-pr-run03/add-stats
